---
title: "Introduction"
---

This document describes how to use the Deltares Fair Data Finder. The Fair Data
Finder consists of 5 tabs, some of which are only limited to a specific set
of users:

| Tab | Access |
|-----|--------|
| [Search](search.qmd) | SSO logged in users |
| [Register](register.qmd) | Deltares employees |
| [Domains](domains.qmd) | Data stewards |
| [Keywords](keywords.qmd) | Data stewards |
| [Groups](groups.qmd) | Admins |

## Logging in

You will be able to see much more functionality when you log in. Clicking
"Login" will forward you to the login screen. Here, you'll be able to log in
using your Deltares credentials.

::: {.callout-tip}
If you are a Deltares employee and use the Edge browser, you'll be
automatically logged in when clicking "Login".
:::
